title: Collection section strip hides the Games vault on iPad portrait (inner pill group scrolls invisibly)
detail: On every Collection page at 820px the vault pill group (Overview, Anime, Books, Visual Novels, Games) is squeezed to 408px of its 484px and scrolls inside itself with its scrollbar hidden. Games is cut off at the right edge with no arrow or fade; the outer section scroller sees no overflow (sw 716 = cw 716) so its arrows never appear. A user on the iPad has no visible way to reach Games from the strip.
evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/collection/empty-mediasync-ipad.png (strip shows Overview..Visual Novels, no Games); eval: .k-seg sw=484 cw=408 x=88, Games item x=483 w=85; shell.subnav-scroller sw=716 cw=716
fix: Give the section's pill group `flex: none` inside `.k-subnav` (css/components.css:80-82) so the overflow moves to the outer `k-subnav-scroller`, which already has arrows; or drop overflow-x:auto from `.k-seg` when it is a child of `.k-subnav`.
rootCause: css/components.css:52 `.k-seg { max-inline-size:100%; overflow-x:auto; scrollbar-width:none }` makes the group's min-content 0, so as a flex child of `.k-subnav` (components.css:80) it shrinks and scrolls itself instead of overflowing the scroller mobile-shell.js:103-125 wraps around the subnav.

title: Collection Overview prints zero-only facts and truncates them on the module cards
detail: Empty account: the four module cards read '0 entries · 0 watching · 0 completed', '0 series · 0 reading · 0 completed · 0 vols …', '0 tracked · 0 playing · 0 routes cleared · 0 …', '0 tracked · 0 playing · 0 hours logged · 0 c…'. Zero supporting facts should be suppressed (invariant 77), and three of the four lines end in an ellipsis at Mac width, so even with data the line is cut.
fix: Build the sub-line from non-zero facts only (show one primary fact, e.g. 'Nothing tracked yet', when all are zero) and cap it at two facts so it fits 247px, or allow it to wrap to two lines.

title: 'Where each medium stands' card renders a legend over an empty body on an empty account
detail: With no titles the Overview's 'Where each medium stands' card shows its title and the Completed/In progress/Planned/Dropped legend but no bars and no empty-state line, so it reads as a broken chart (invariant 76 asks for an honest low-data state).
fix: When every module total is 0, hide the legend and print one line ('Statuses appear once a vault has titles') or hide the card and let Airing soon take the row.

title: Mangaka is marked as the Anime page (strip lights Anime; phone header reads 'Anime')
devices: all; most visible on iPhone where the page title says Anime
detail: Mangaka is built from the Books vault ('Every author on your shelves', its Actions go to the Books vault) but the section strip highlights Anime as current, and the phone shell's section title above the page reads 'Anime ▾'. Current-location marking is wrong and confusing (you came from Books).
fix: In js/core/ui.js:1467 map mangaka to 'books' (keep seasonal → anime).

title: Mangaka takes ~3 s to render on the dense account (reads and groups every book on each open)
detail: Navigating Home → #/mangaka with 1,107 books took ~2.9 s until the DOM settled (Books vault 1.5 s, Anime 1.1 s, Overview 0.8 s). The page queries the whole Books module, groups by author and computes works/volumes/chapters per author in the sort comparator (worksOf/mkVols/mkChapters re-filter per comparison), every paint and on every search keystroke.
evidence: eval timing: {'#/mangaka':2925ms,'#/books':1554,'#/anime':1074,'#/matrix':792,'#/shrine':882}; js/modules/books.js:1651 (full query), 1600-1603 (sort comparator recomputing worksOf per comparison)
fix: Precompute per-author aggregates once per filter change (a map name→{works, vols, ch}) and sort on the cached values; cache the grouped rows between visits keyed on the vault's change counter.
rootCause: Per-comparison recomputation in the sort (O(n log n × works)) plus an unbounded module read on every open.

title: Small touch targets across Collection controls on iPad/iPhone (sort selects 30px, Mangaka letters 32px, Wishlist checkboxes 18px, Sync radios 13px)
detail: With a coarse pointer: vault sort selects (Anime/Books/VN/Games/Shrine) are 173x30, Seasonal season select 104x30 and year field 96x31, Wishlist sort 132x30, Wishlist 'Simulate buying' checkboxes 18x18, Mangaka jump letters 32x32, Sync's autonomous-sync switch 34x20 and the XML import-mode radios 13x13. Invariant 69 asks for 44px on coarse pointers.
evidence: DOM measurement at ipad/iphone (col-seed-ipad.json): SMALL ui.status-select vault.sort 173x30; mangaka.jump 32x32; plan.check 18x18; sync.auto-toggle 34x20; input radio 13x13
fix: Apply the coarse-pointer min block size to `.k-select`/status-select and the year input in components.css; wrap the Wishlist checkboxes and Sync radios in 44px labels; give `.k-mk-key` 44px under (pointer:coarse).

title: Vault toolbar wraps into three ragged rows on iPad portrait ('Find new' alone on a row, count alone above)
detail: At 820px the Books/Anime/VN/Games controls block is 131px tall: the count ('738 series') sits on its own line, search/sort/filters/view/actions on a second, and the primary 'Find new' button alone on a third line at the left, under a separate 'Status & lists' row. The grid starts ~713px down the page. Ragged wrap with dead width on rows 1 and 3.
evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/collection/seed-anime-ipad.png; eval: vault.count @88,588; search @88,619 253x44 … Actions @721,619; 'Find new' @88,675 111x44; controls block 716x131
fix: In the medview toolbar, put the count inside the search row (as on Mac) and let the primary button take the Actions slot (or fold Find new into Actions) under 860px, so the toolbar is one row plus the Status & lists button; or make 'Status & lists' share that row.
rootCause: js/modules/medview.js toolbar() lays the count, the control row and the primary button out as separate flex items that wrap independently below the 1080 tier.

title: No link out to the title's AniList/VNDB page, and nowhere to keep 'where I watch/read it' (QoL)
detail: The editor shows 'Linked to AniList' and knows anilistId/malId/vndbId, but only Games has an outbound link ('View on Steam ↗', games.js:333). Anime/Books/VN have no 'Open on AniList/VNDB' and no personal 'Where I'm watching/reading' URL. Proposal for the watch link: a manual-layer field `links: [{label, url}]` (or a single `watchUrl`) added in mediadb.normalise (js/core/mediadb.js:542, sanitised to http(s) only, no index so no DB version bump — like physical.seriesTotal), preserved in merge() beside notes/tags (mediadb.js ~1062: `inc.links = old.links.length ? old.links : inc.links`), unioned in foldLocal (mediadb.js:934) and covered by materialJSON automatically; never pushed (invariant 13 payloads stay status/progress/score) and excluded from search (71). UI: an input on 'Your layer' with a 'Use clipboard' helper; a '▶ Watch' / '📖 Read' button beside '+1 ep' on the card hover row, the Spotlight hero and the editor header, opening in a new tab (rel=noopener). The provider page link (AniList/VNDB) can be derived from the ids and shown on the Record tab.
evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/collection/seed-anime-editor-layer-mac.png, /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/collection/seed-anime-editor-record-mac.png; grep: only js/modules/games.js:57,333 build an outbound title URL
fix: Add the field to normalise/merge/foldLocal as above, a URL input in the shared editor's personal layer (KOS.mediaEditors), and a Watch/Read action in medview's card and hero.

title: Favourite heart on vault cards is a generic 'Toggle favourite' with no visible label and an easy mis-tap
detail: The heart button on every card is labelled 'Toggle favourite' (aria-pressed is set, good) but sits at the card's top-right where a tap meant to open the card toggles the favourite instantly with no toast/undo; a Shrine membership changes silently. Measured 34x34 (below 44 on touch).
evidence: eval: card button aria-label 'Toggle favourite', aria-pressed 'false', 34x34; reproduced an accidental favourite by clicking the card's first button
fix: Label as 'Favourite <title>' / 'Remove <title> from favourites', show a toast with Undo ('Added to the Shrine'), and give it 44px on coarse pointers.

title: Back (or any route change) leaves a vault editor open over the next page; Save then edits a title from another vault
devices: Mac browser (Back key/gesture), iPad Safari tab (edge swipe)
detail: Open an Anime title's editor, then press Back: the page behind changes to the previous route (Games) but the Anime editor drawer stays open on top of it. Navigating by hash with the editor open does the same — screenshots of #/books and #/vn still show 'Collection entry 686' (an anime) with Log episode. The modal no longer belongs to the page under it and its Save writes the anime row while the user is looking at Games/VN.
evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/collection/seed-books-mac.png and /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/collection/seed-vn-mac.png (anime editor over Books/VN); eval: open=1 hash=#/anime → history.back() → afterBack=1 hash=#/game h1=Games
fix: On a routed navigation (router.js onPop/renderRoute, and KOS.show without _redraw) close every open KOS.ui.openDialog overlay first (cancel semantics, or ask if dirty), or have openDialog push a history entry so Back closes the dialog instead of the page.
rootCause: js/core/router.js:283-297 onPop re-renders the view with KOS.show but nothing closes overlays opened by KOS.ui.openDialog (js/core/ui.js:155), which live outside #main.

title: Books status rail counts the whole module while the grid shows one lens ('All 1107' beside '738 series')
detail: On Books (Digital lens, the default) the rail reads All 1107 / In progress 221 / … while the toolbar count says 738 series and the grid holds 738. Switching to Physical Vault keeps the same rail numbers. Clicking a status therefore shows fewer titles than its count promises.
evidence: eval on #/books: rail 'All 1107','In progress 221'…; vault.count '738 series'; lens 'Digital:true'
fix: Pass the active lens predicate to filterRail (e.g. filterRail(module, onChange, {filter: lensFn})) and count only rows that pass it; recount when the lens changes.
rootCause: js/modules/medview.js:1704-1712 reload() counts `KOS.mediadb.query({module})` — every row of the module — with no knowledge of the Books lens set in js/modules/books.js:1131.

title: Spotlight says 'the last one is next' when every route/episode is already done
detail: A VN in progress at 2/2 routes reads '2 routes in — the last one is next.' The branch fires when left === 0, i.e. nothing is left; 'the last one is next' describes left === 1. Same for an anime/book at its final episode/chapter count.
evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/collection/seed-vn-mac.png (hero: '2 routes in — the last one is next.', chip 2 / 2 routes)
fix: left === 0 → 'All N in — ready to mark it complete?' (offer a Complete action); left === 1 → 'the last one is next.'

title: 'Hide amounts' does not hide money on the Wishlist, Mangaka or the Books shelf; currency is formatted three different ways
detail: With Money's Hide amounts on (state.ui.moneyHidden = true) the Money page shows no figures, but the Wishlist still prints 'GBP 10.00', 'GBP 60.00 left of GBP 60.00', 'GBP 105.00', and Mangaka prints '£755 spent' on every author card. Invariant 5a says Hide amounts masks every amount on every surface. The same values are also formatted inconsistently: Money/Wishlist 'GBP 10.00' (ISO code + space, mono), Books/Mangaka a hard-coded '£755' / '£12.50' that ignores the user's currency setting.
evidence: eval with moneyHidden=true: money page matches [] ; wishlist ['GBP 10.00','GBP 60.00',…]; mangaka ['£755 spent',…]; /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/collection/seed-wishlist-mac.png, /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/collection/seed-mangaka-mac.png
fix: Route every Collection amount through KOS.ui.amount (minor units, currency from KOS.money): wishlist.js money() (544-548), books.js:363 (Shelf value), books.js:1531 (author 'spent'), books.js:454 placeholder, and the Overview/analytics 'spent' figures.
rootCause: js/modules/wishlist.js:544-548 and js/modules/books.js:363,1531 format money with string concatenation instead of the shared KOS.ui.amount primitive that owns masking and currency.

title: Seasonal hero's art credit is unreadable on the painted scenery (Mac/iPad)
detail: The credit 'art · kamo_nasus' is 11.5px muted grey (oklch 0.62) laid straight over bright foliage with no scrim, jammed against the Art menu button; at 1x it is close to invisible (on iPhone it sits on a darker patch and reads). The credit is a licensing obligation for hot-linked scenery (invariant 94).

title: Seasonal controls on iPhone wrap into a ragged block (segmented control alone, right-aligned)
detail: Season select and year field share row 1 (year field stops at 279 leaving 107px empty), the In progress/Everything switch sits alone right-aligned on row 2 with the left half empty, then Refresh airing/Anime vault on row 3. Three rows of controls and a dead half-row before the first title.
